static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.medical_history: deny类似心理问题史;not yet接受过心理治疗;No major physical illness史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑性较好;态度偏消极但配合度较高;常出现Self-denial与怀疑;语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 在涉及欺骗或说谎的社交情境中,感到without能和without用,近几年更为突出并影响社交关系.
basic_info.core_demands: 希望在Social situations更自信,not在需要虚张声势或说谎时立刻认为自己without能.
growth_experiences: 几年前的一次社交活动中,为了掩盖自己的错误而not得not说谎;该事件最初引发的压力为中等,随后问题逐步升级,来访者在需要欺骗/说谎的社交情境中Persistent self-doubt并回避参与,最终影响社交互动与Interpersonal relationships.来访者曾尝试通过阅读社交互动相关书籍与练习说谎来改善,但感到效果有限.

core_beliefs: 如果我not能有效撒谎或虚张声势,就说明我在社交中not行

special_situations.event: When playing friendship poker / games requiring bluffing with colleagues or friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能成功地 bluff 或说谎,就证明我是一个without用的玩家/not适合社交
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids participating in such games; improves skills by reading social books and practicing lying
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我without法拉起一个有效的虚张声势,我就是个without用的玩家

special_situations.event: In social activities, needs to lie to cover up one's mistakes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能圆谎或被看出not擅长欺骗,我会被羞辱,关系会受损
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Speaks less, quickly leaves the situation, or avoids similar occasions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I mess up, things will get very bad

special_situations.event: When interacting with colleagues who like jokes and 'benign deception'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能跟上他们的玩笑和欺骗,我就会被看not起或被排斥
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 谨慎少言,保持距离或not参与相关互动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am terrible,很扫兴

special_situations.event: 意识到自己Worknot yet受影响且有支持性的朋友,但仍面对需要欺骗的社交情境
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 除非我能像do not人一样熟练地说谎/bluff,否则任何积极方面都not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极反馈与支持,持续关注自身not足
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些优点not重要,我还是not行

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted socially, seen as capable, and able to interact with ease
core_conflict.fear: 害怕暴露without能被羞辱或Being rejected,担心失败导致关系受损
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of safety and self-esteem by avoiding social scenarios requiring deception/lying

object_relations.self_representation: not擅长欺骗,容易被看穿的'without能参与者'

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes conducting a behavioral experiment or suggests practicing bluff in low-risk occasions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将可能的Learning尝试视为一场'能力检验',若失败就证明自己without能(对失败的Anticipation放大)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 表达对失败的担忧(如'如果not成功怎么办'),语气谨慎而礼貌,请求循序渐进的小步尝试,避免深入触及羞耻情绪.

manifestations: Reduces participation in socializing by avoiding social activities involving deception/lying
Difficulty trusting others, difficulty joining in jokes and relaxed interaction

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worrying behavioral experiments will fail, asking for gradual steps
Is cautious in interactions involving deception and reduces participation

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 拥有支持性的朋友却not分享自己的困扰
not主动寻求外部帮助与支持,转而通过自我Repression与回避来应对

positive_force: Has a supportive network of friends
Willing to try behavioral experiments and accept gradual strategies
职业功能not yet受直接影响,保持一定稳定性
Once proactively self-helped (read social-interaction books, practiced)
negative_force: Difficulty trusting others, difficulty joining in jokes and relaxed interaction
认知偏差显著(negate正面,心理过滤,过度概括,个人化)

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids social interactions involving deception or bluffing (such as jokes, friendly poker)
antecedent: Interacts with colleagues who like jokes and 'benevolent deception'
Scenarios requiring lying to cover up mistakes
target_behavior.core_reason: 在几年前的社交事件中因说谎掩盖错误而形成'without能/without用'的自我评价,担心被看穿与被评判,以避免羞耻与失败
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪(Shame, anxiety)与潜在的负面评价,维持短期安全感
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships受影响,Reduced socializing参与,产生Sense of isolation与Persistent self-doubt和痛苦
